title: Assessing the real-world economic value of weather forecasts for compounding extremes
abstract: Assessing the real-world economic value (EV) of weather forecasts remains challenging, particularly in the context of high-impact extreme events. Meteorological forecast skill has improved substantially in recent years, driven by steady advances in physics-based models and breakthroughs in AI-based forecasting. However, operational evaluations typically provide limited consideration to how these improvements in meteorological skill translate into EV. The economic evaluation frameworks that do exist are ill-suited to extreme weather event, which often do not occur in isolation. In this study, we present a flexible framework to assess the EV of weather forecasts, with penalty functions that explicitly account for compounding losses from multiple extreme events, as well as declining user trust in case of repeated false alarms. In addition, the framework allows for varying cost-loss ratios to represent heterogeneous prevention costs and vulnerability structures. We apply the framework to cities exposed to extreme weather hazards, and directly compare the relative EV of leading physics-based and data-driven forecasting systems from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts. The value of forecasts is highly sensitive to assumptions about compounding losses, penalty structures, and prevention costs-often substantially altering conclusions drawn from meteorological skill alone. For instance, in some cities in Southern Europe, the higher sensitivity of the physics-based model IFS HRES makes it better-suited when protection costs are small relative to potential losses, while the higher specificity of the data-driven AIFS makes it better when protection costs are higher. These findings underscore the importance of evaluating EV under realistic risk scenarios to ensure that improvements in predictive accuracy translate into meaningful societal and economic benefits.
abstract_zh: 评估天气预报的现实经济价值（EV）仍然具有挑战性，在高影响极端事件的背景下尤其如此。近年来，基于物理的模型不断进步，以及基于人工智能的预报取得突破，使气象预报技能得到了大幅提升。然而，业务化评估通常很少考虑这些气象技能的提高如何转化为经济价值。现有的经济评估框架并不适合极端天气事件，因为这些事件往往并非孤立发生。在本研究中，我们提出了一个灵活的框架来评估天气预报的经济价值，该框架设有惩罚函数，明确考虑了多次极端事件造成的复合损失，以及因重复误报而导致的用户信任下降。此外，该框架允许使用不同的成本损失比，以代表异质性的防护成本和脆弱性结构。我们将该框架应用于面临极端天气灾害的城市，并直接比较了欧洲中期天气预报中心（ECMWF）领先的基于物理的预报系统与数据驱动预报系统的相对经济价值。预报价值对复合损失、惩罚结构和防护成本的假设高度敏感，往往会显著改变仅基于气象技能所得出的结论。例如，在南欧的一些城市，当防护成本相对于潜在损失较小时，基于物理的模型IFS HRES的较高敏感性使其更为适用；而当防护成本较高时，数据驱动的AIFS的较高特异性则使其更为适用。这些发现强调了在现实风险情景下评估经济价值的重要性，以确保预测精度的提高能够转化为有意义的社会和经济效益。

title: Assessing the value of impact-based forecasting and early action for floods
venue: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction
abstract: This paper assesses the effectiveness of Impact-based Flood forecasts (IbF) in reducing flood impacts. The new system is developed in the Geographical, Environmental, and Behavioural (GEB-IbF) model framework, where it is applied to the April–May 2024 flood in the Sinos River catchment, southern Brazil. The system correctly issued evacuation warnings to 88,883 households (76.1% of all flooded households) and recommended protective measures that reduced estimated flood damages by $4–5 million. Comparing conventional meteorological warnings (MW) and general flood warnings (FW) with impact-based warnings (IbW) demonstrates that IbW provide timely, useful, and actionable information. IbW enhances a flood early warning system in four main ways: (I) IbW reach a larger number of administrative units (593-708 for IbW vs. 580-682 for FW), especially upstream and rural areas; (II) IbW reduce falsely warned households by 19.9% (in medium flood scenarios) and 33.5% (in severe flood scenarios) compared to FW; (III) IbW prompt more affected households to act, with 4–11% more households correctly evacuating and implementing protective actions; and (IV) IbW achieve greater damage reduction (25.2-30.6% of total damage) than FW (21.9-21.6%), under the medium and severe flood scenarios, respectively. These results highlight the need for investment in operational flood forecasting and continuous gathering of impact-related data. Besides, this study shows that improved human response to warnings can double avoided damage and evacuations, emphasizing the urgency for continuous training and awareness raising among the local population. Therefore, local and community authorities are key actors in further increasing the warning effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了基于影响的洪水预报（IbF）在减少洪水影响方面的有效性。新系统在地理、环境与行为（GEB-IbF）模型框架中开发，并应用于2024年4月至5月巴西南部Sinos河流域的洪水。该系统正确地向88,883户家庭（占所有受淹家庭的76.1%）发出了疏散预警，并建议了防护措施，从而使估计的洪水损失减少了400万至500万美元。比较常规气象预警（MW）和一般洪水预警（FW）与基于影响的预警（IbW），表明IbW提供了及时、有用且可操作的信息。IbW主要从四个方面改进了洪水预警系统：（I）IbW覆盖的行政单元数量更多（IbW为593至708个，FW为580至682个），尤其是上游和农村地区；（II）与FW相比，IbW使误警家庭减少19.9%（在中等洪水情景下）和33.5%（在严重洪水情景下）；（III）IbW促使更多受影响家庭采取行动，正确疏散并实施防护措施的家庭增加4%至11%；（IV）在中等和严重洪水情景下，IbW实现的损失减少幅度（分别为总损失的25.2%至30.6%）大于FW（分别为21.9%至21.6%）。这些结果凸显了投资于业务化洪水预报以及持续收集与影响相关数据的必要性。此外，本研究表明，改进的人类对预警的响应可以使避免的损失和疏散人数翻倍，这凸显了对当地居民持续开展培训和提高意识的紧迫性。因此，地方和社区当局是进一步提高预警效果的关键行为主体。

title: Worldwide Job Losses Due to Natural Hazards
Carbon pricing and transit accessibility to jobs
venue: Transportation Research Part D Transport and Environment
abstract: Urban transport is a major driver of global carbon dioxide emissions. Without strong mitigation policies, rapid urbanization, especially in developing countries, is expected to exacerbate the problem. There is a growing consensus on the fundamental role of carbon pricing for achieving reductions in carbon dioxide emissions. However, carbon pricing policies are frequently criticized and resisted for having adverse distributional impacts, which could hinder their implementation, particularly when implemented as a fuel levy—which would impact private vehicle usage but may also affect transit services such as buses. Currently, there is a lack of evidence that quantifies these negative impacts, especially on people’s ability to reach economic opportunities and services. To this end, this paper studies the impact of a uniform carbon price, as one of the most commonly discussed climate policies, on access to employment opportunities via transit services in Kinshasa and Rio de Janeiro. Reduced access to jobs would contribute to fragmented urban labor markets and thus lead to negative social outcomes. Unlike most previous studies, this study defines access as being constrained by both travel time and travel budget. The results indicate that fuel price increases (simulating increases induced by a carbon tax) reduce accessibility, but the effect is lower in more compact and walkable cities as well as in cities that have green transit options. The paper also shows that fuel price increases have spatially and socially disparate outcomes, with the lowest income communities not necessarily being the most affected, in part because even in the absence of carbon pricing, they are found to be priced out of using transit services. The results demonstrate the importance of strategies and investments, such as land use planning and decarbonized transit services, but also possibly complementary social protection programs (such as targeted subsidies, or even cash transfers), to mitigate the negative distributional consequences of carbon pricing policies.
abstract_zh: 城市交通是全球二氧化碳排放的主要来源。如果没有强有力的减排政策，快速城市化（尤其是在发展中国家）预计将加剧这一问题。学界日益形成共识，认为碳定价在减少二氧化碳排放方面具有根本性作用。然而，碳定价政策常因其对分配的不利影响而遭到批评和抵制，这可能阻碍其实施，尤其是当其以燃油税的形式实施时——这会影响私家车的使用，也可能波及公共交通服务，如公交车。目前，缺乏量化这些负面影响的证据，特别是对人们抵达经济机会和服务的能力的影响。为此，本文以Kinshasa（金沙萨）和Rio de Janeiro（里约热内卢）为例，研究了统一碳价这一最常被讨论的气候政策之一对通过公共交通抵达就业机会的可达性的影响。就业可达性下降将导致城市劳动力市场碎片化，进而带来负面的社会后果。与大多数已有研究不同，本文将可达性定义为同时受出行时间和出行预算约束。结果表明，燃油价格上涨（模拟碳税引起的涨价）会降低可达性，但在更紧凑、更适宜步行的城市以及拥有绿色公共交通选择的城市中，这一效应较小。本文还表明，燃油价格上涨的空间和社会影响存在差异，收入最低的社区不一定受影响最大，部分原因在于即使在没有碳定价的情况下，他们也已被排除在公共交通服务之外。研究结果表明，土地利用规划和脱碳公共交通服务等战略和投资，以及可能配套的社会保障计划（如定向补贴，甚至现金转移支付），对于减轻碳定价政策的负面分配后果具有重要意义。

title: The Economic Value of Weather Forecasts: A Quantitative Systematic Literature Review
abstract: This study systematically reviews the literature that quantifies the economic benefits of weather observations and forecasts in four weather-dependent economic sectors: agriculture, energy, transport, and disaster-risk management. The review covers 175 peer-reviewed journal articles and 15 policy reports. Findings show that the literature is concentrated in high-income countries and most studies use theoretical models, followed by observational and then experimental research designs. Forecast horizons studied, meteorological variables and services, and monetization techniques vary markedly by sector. Estimated benefits even within specific subsectors span several orders of magnitude and broad uncertainty ranges. An econometric meta-analysis suggests that theoretical studies and studies in richer countries tend to report significantly larger values. Barriers that hinder value realization are identified on both the provider and user sides, with inadequate relevance, weak dissemination, and limited ability to act recurring across sectors. Policy reports rely heavily on back-of-the-envelope or recursive benefit-transfer estimates, rather than on the methods and results of the peer-reviewed literature, revealing a science-to-policy gap. These findings suggest substantial socioeconomic potential of hydrometeorological services around the world, but also knowledge gaps that require more valuation studies focusing on low- and middle-income countries, addressing provider- and user-side barriers and employing rigorous empirical valuation methods to complement and validate theoretical models.
abstract_zh: 本研究系统回顾了量化天气观测和预报在四个依赖天气的经济部门（农业、能源、交通和灾害风险管理）中经济效益的文献。综述涵盖175篇同行评审期刊论文和15份政策报告。研究发现，相关文献集中于高收入国家，大多数研究采用理论模型，其次是观测研究，再次是实验研究设计。不同部门所研究的预报时效、气象变量与服务以及货币化方法差异显著。即使在特定子部门内，估计的效益也跨越数个数量级，且不确定性范围很宽。计量元分析表明，理论研究和较富裕国家的研究往往报告显著更大的价值。研究还识别出阻碍价值实现的障碍，既存在于服务提供方，也存在于用户方，包括相关性不足、传播薄弱以及各部门普遍存在的行动能力有限等问题。政策报告严重依赖粗略估算或递归式效益迁移估计，而非依据同行评审文献中的方法和结果，这揭示了科学与政策之间的差距。这些发现表明，全球水文气象服务具有可观的社会经济潜力，但也存在知识空白，需要开展更多聚焦低收入和中等收入国家的价值评估研究，应对提供方和用户方的障碍，并采用严谨的实证估值方法，以补充和验证理论模型。

title: Early Warnings Coverage, Determinants of Reception, and Benefits: What Surveys Can Tell Us
Distributional Impacts of Carbon Pricing on Accessibility Across Space and Incomes
venue: International Journal of Advanced Studies in Business Strategies and Management
abstract: Urban transport is a major driver of global CO2 emissions, and, without strong mitigation strategies, its contribution is likely to increase with the rapid urbanization occurring in developing countries. There is a growing consensus on the fundamental role of carbon pricing for reducing CO2 emissions. However, carbon pricing policies are frequently criticized and resisted for having adverse distributional impacts, especially when they impact transit services, the cheapest motorized transport means. Policies affecting transport costs have impacts on household well-being. In the short term, they impact how much income is left after commuting expenses are incurred. But more generally, they impact accessibility to jobs, which is associated with reduced unemployment, better-paid jobs, and more formal and permanent employment. Accessibility is also a key determinant of where people can afford to live in urban areas. Carbon pricing can therefore negatively impact households, especially the poorest, by locking them out of the labor market or constraining them to live in locations with high housing costs.
abstract_zh: 城市交通是全球CO2排放的主要来源，如果不采取强有力的减排策略，随着发展中国家正在发生的快速城市化，其排放贡献可能会继续增加。学界日益形成共识，认为碳定价在减少CO2排放方面具有根本性作用。然而，碳定价政策常因其对分配的不利影响而遭到批评和抵制，尤其是当其影响到作为最廉价机动化交通方式的公共交通服务时。影响交通成本的政策会对家庭福利产生影响。短期来看，这些政策会影响通勤支出之后剩余的收入。但从更广泛的意义上讲，它们影响人们获得就业机会的可达性，而这与失业率下降、薪资更高的工作以及更正规、更稳定的就业相关联。可达性也是决定人们能否负担得起在城市某地居住的关键因素。因此，碳定价可能对家庭造成负面影响，尤其是对最贫困的家庭，使他们被挡在劳动力市场之外，或迫使他们居住在住房成本高昂的地区。

title: Climate Policy and Inequality in Urban Areas: Beyond Incomes
abstract: Opposition to climate policies seems to arise, at least partly, from their effects on inequality. However, so far, the impact of climate policies on inequality has mainly been studied through the lens of income inequality, and their spatial dimension is poorly understood. This paper, using Cape Town, South Africa, as a case study, investigates the impact of a fuel tax on both spatial and income inequalities. It uses a model derived from the standard urban economics land use model, accounting for four income classes and four housing types. This modeling framework allows decomposing the impacts of the tax by income class, housing type, and housing location. The analysis also decomposes the impacts of the tax over different timeframes, assuming that households and developers progressively adapt to the tax. The findings reveal strong evidence that in the short term, there are both income and spatial inequalities, with households being more negatively impacted by the fuel tax if they earn low incomes or live far from employment centers. In the medium and long term, these inequalities persist: the poorest households, living in informal settlements or subsidized housing, have few or no ways to adapt to changes in fuel prices by changing housing type, adjusting their dwelling sizes or locations, or shifting transportation modes. Low-income households living in formal housing also remain impacted by the tax over the long term due to complex effects driven by the competition with richer households on the housing market. Complementary policies promoting a functioning labor market that allows people to change jobs easily, affordable public transportation, or subsidies helping low-income households to rent houses closer to employment centers will be key to enable the social acceptability of climate policies.
abstract_zh: 反对气候政策的声音，至少部分源于其对不平等的影响。然而，迄今为止，气候政策对不平等的影响主要是从收入不平等的角度进行研究的，其空间维度则鲜为人知。本文以南非开普敦为案例，考察燃油税对空间不平等和收入不平等的影响。研究采用了一个源自标准城市经济学土地利用模型的框架，纳入四个收入阶层和四种住房类型。该建模框架使得能够按收入阶层、住房类型和住房位置分解税收的影响。分析还假设家庭和开发商会逐步适应税收，从而按不同时间尺度分解税收的影响。研究结果有力地表明，短期内同时存在收入不平等和空间不平等：收入较低或居住在远离就业中心的家庭，受燃油税的负面影响更大。在中期和长期，这些不平等依然存在：居住在非正规住区或保障性住房中的最贫困家庭，几乎没有或完全没有办法通过改变住房类型、调整住房面积或居住地点，或转换交通方式来适应燃油价格的变化。居住在正规住房中的低收入家庭，由于与较富裕家庭在住房市场上的竞争所引发的复杂效应，在长期内同样受到税收的影响。促进劳动力市场良好运转（使人们能够便捷地更换工作）、提供负担得起的公共交通，或提供补贴以帮助低收入家庭租住更靠近就业中心的住房的配套政策，将是使气候政策获得社会接受度的关键。

title: Global evidence of rapid urban growth in flood zones since 1985
abstract: As countries urbanize, human settlements are rapidly expanding into hazardous flood zones. This study provides a global analysis of spatial urbanization patterns and the evolution of flood exposure between 1985 and 2015. Using high-resolution annual data, it shows that settlements across the world grew by 85 percent to over 1.28 million square kilometers. In the same period, settlements exposed to the highest flood hazard level increased by 122 percent. In many regions, risky growth is outpacing safe growth, particularly in East Asia, where high risk settlements have expanded 60 percent faster than safe ones. Developing countries are driving the recent growth of flood exposure: 82 percent of the 36,500 square kilometers of settlements built in the world’s highest-risk zones since 1985 are in low- and middle-income countries. In comparison, recent growth in high-income countries has been relatively slow and safe. These results document a divergence in countries’ exposure to flood hazards. Rather than adapting their exposure to climatic hazards, many countries are actively increasing their exposure.
abstract_zh: 随着各国城市化，人类居住区正迅速扩张到危险的洪泛区。本研究对1985至2015年间全球城市化空间格局及洪水暴露的演变进行了全球分析。利用高分辨率年度数据，研究表明，全球居住区增长了85%，达到超过128万平方公里。同一时期，暴露于最高洪水灾害等级的居住区增长了122%。在许多地区，危险增长的速度超过了安全增长，特别是在东亚，高风险居住区的扩张速度比安全居住区快60%。发展中国家正在推动近期洪水暴露的增长：自1985年以来，全球在最高风险区域新建的3.65万平方公里居住区中，82%位于中低收入国家。相比之下，高收入国家的近期增长相对缓慢且较为安全。这些结果表明，各国在洪水灾害暴露方面出现了分化。许多国家并未使其暴露程度适应气候灾害，反而正在积极增加这种暴露。

title: Efficiency and Equity in Urban Flood Management Policies: A Systematic Urban Economics Exploration
abstract: Flood exposure is likely to increase in the future as a direct consequence of more frequent and more intense flooding and the growth of populations and economic assets in flood-prone areas. Low-income households, which are more likely to be located in high-risk zones, will be particularly affected. This paper assesses the welfare and equity impacts of three flood management policies—risk-based insurance, zoning, and subsidized insurance—using an urban economics framework with two income groups and three potential flood locations. The paper shows that in a first-best setting, risk-based insurance maximizes social welfare. However, depending on flood characteristics, implementing a zoning policy or subsidized insurance is close to optimal and can be more feasible. Subsidizing insurance reduces upward pressure on housing rents but increases flood damage, and is recommended for rare floods occurring in a large part of a city. Zoning policies have the opposite effect, avoiding damage but increasing housing rents, and are recommended for frequent floods in small areas. The social welfare impact of choosing the wrong flood management policy depends on the location of floods relative to employment centers, with flooding close to employment centers being particularly harmful. Implementing flood management policies redistributes flood costs between high- and low-income households through land markets, irrespective of who is directly affected. As such, they are progressive in terms of equity, compared to a laissez-faire scenario with myopic anticipations, in the more common scenario where poorer populations are more exposed to urban floods. But their impacts on inequality depend on flood locations and urban configuration. For instance, in a city where floods are centrally located and low-income households live in the city center, subsidized insurance would mitigate a surge in inequality, whereas a zoning policy could substantially increase inequalities.
abstract_zh: 由于洪水更加频繁和强烈，以及易受洪水侵袭地区的人口和经济资产增长，未来洪水暴露风险可能会增加。低收入家庭更可能位于高风险区域，将受到尤为严重的影响。本文运用一个包含两个收入群体和三个潜在洪水位置的城市经济学框架，评估了三种洪水管理政策——基于风险的保险、分区管制和补贴保险——的福利和公平影响。研究表明，在最优情形下，基于风险的保险能够使社会福利最大化。然而，取决于洪水特征，实施分区管制或补贴保险接近最优，且可能更具可行性。补贴保险可以减轻房租的上涨压力，但会增加洪水损失，适用于覆盖城市大部分区域的罕见洪水。分区管制政策则产生相反的效果：避免了损失，但会推高房租，适用于小范围内的频繁洪水。选择错误的洪水管理政策对社会福利的影响，取决于洪水相对于就业中心的位置，其中靠近就业中心的洪水危害尤为严重。洪水管理政策通过土地市场在高收入和低收入家庭之间重新分配洪水成本，而不论谁是直接受影响者。因此，在较常见的情形下（较贫困人口更易受城市洪水侵害），与具有短视预期的自由放任情景相比，这些政策在公平方面具有累进性。但其对不平等的影响取决于洪水位置和城市格局。例如，在洪水集中于城市中心、低收入家庭居住在市中心的城市中，补贴保险可以缓解不平等的加剧，而分区管制则可能大幅扩大不平等。

title: Flood Protection and Land Value Creation – Not all Resilience Investments Are Created Equal
venue: Economics of Disasters and Climate Change
abstract: No AccessPolicy Research Working Papers11 Aug 2021Flood Protection and Land Value Creation — not All Resilience Investments are Created EqualAuthors/Editors: Paolo Avner, Vincent Viguié, Bramka Arga Jafino, Stephane HallegattePaolo Avner, Vincent Viguié, Bramka Arga Jafino, Stephane Hallegattehttps://doi.org/10.1596/1813-9450-9744SectionsAboutPDF (4 MB) ToolsAdd to favoritesDownload CitationsTrack Citations ShareFacebookTwitterLinked In Abstract: This paper investigates the land value creation potential from flood mitigation investments in a theoretical and applied setting, using the urban area of Buenos Aires as a case study. It contributes to the literature on the wider economic benefits of government interventions and the dividends of resilience investments. Using a simple urban economics framework that represents land and housing markets, it finds that not all flood mitigation interventions display the same potential for land value creation: where land is more valuable (city centers for example), the benefits of resilience are higher. The paper also provides ranges for land value creation potential from the flood mitigation works in Buenos Aires under various model specifications. Although the estimates vary largely depending on model parameters and specifications, in many cases the land value creation would be sufficient to justify the investments. This result is robust even in the closed city configuration with conservative flood damage estimates, providing that the parameters remain reasonably close to the values obtained from the calibration. Finally, acknowledging that fully calibrating and running an urban simulation model is data greedy and time intensive—even a simple model as proposed here—this research also proposes reduced form expressions that can provide approximations for land value creation from flood mitigation investments and can be used in operational contexts. abstract_zh: 无访问限制 政策研究工作论文 2021年8月11日 防洪与土地价值创造——并非所有韧性投资都同样有效 作者/编辑：Paolo Avner, Vincent Viguié, Bramka Arga Jafino, Stephane Hallegatte Paolo Avner, Vincent Viguié, Bramka Arga Jafino, Stephane Hallegatte https://doi.org/10.1596/1813-9450-9744 章节 关于 PDF（4 MB） 工具 添加到收藏 下载引用 跟踪引用 分享 Facebook Twitter LinkedIn 摘要：本文以布宜诺斯艾利斯市区为案例，在理论和应用层面考察了防洪投资的土地价值创造潜力。本文对政府干预的更广泛经济效益以及韧性投资红利的文献做出了贡献。利用一个刻画土地和住房市场的简单城市经济学框架，本文发现，并非所有防洪措施都具有相同的土地价值创造潜力：土地价值越高的地区（例如城市中心），韧性的收益就越大。本文还给出了在各种模型设定下布宜诺斯艾利斯防洪工程的土地价值创造潜力区间。尽管估计结果因模型参数和设定而差异很大，但在许多情况下，土地价值创造足以证明投资的合理性。即使在封闭城市设定下采用保守的洪灾损失估计，只要参数与校准得到的数值保持合理接近，该结论依然稳健。最后，考虑到完全校准和运行城市模拟模型需要大量数据且耗时，即便是本文提出的简单模型也是如此，本研究还提出了简化形式的表达式，可用于近似估计防洪投资带来的土地价值创造，并适用于实际操作场景。上一本书 下一本书 图表 参考文献 推荐详情 查看 出版时间：2021年7月 版权与许可 关键词：住宅投资 防洪 城市经济发展 住房管制 土地利用 交通规划 PDF下载 加载中……

title: Where are All the Jobs? A Machine Learning Approach for High Resolution Urban Employment Prediction in Developing Countries
Flood impacts on urban transit and accessibility—A case study of Kinshasa
venue: Transportation Research Part D Transport and Environment
abstract: Transportation networks underpin socioeconomic development by enabling the movement of goods and people. However, despite their frequency, little is known about how floods disrupt transportation systems in developing country cities. We collect an innovative dual-condition transit feed specification dataset, and combine it with a travel survey and high-resolution flood maps to examine how regular floods in Kinshasa impact transport services, job accessibility, and the associated economic opportunity costs from travel delays. Our results show that flood disruptions cause increases in public transit headways, transit rerouting, decreases in travel speeds, which translate into travel delays and loss of job accessibility. This induces substantial economic costs to local commuters – about $1.2 million daily – and hinders the establishment of an integrated citywide labor market. In addition, we reveal sizeable socio-spatial heterogeneities, with clusters of low-income residents incurring a large share of the travel delays and identify critical network segments that should be prioritized for resilience interventions.
abstract_zh: 交通网络通过促进货物和人员的流动，支撑着社会经济发展。然而，尽管洪水频繁发生，人们对其如何扰乱发展中国家城市的交通系统却知之甚少。我们收集了一个创新的双条件公共交通时刻表数据集，并将其与出行调查和高分辨率洪水地图相结合，考察了金沙萨的常规洪水如何影响交通服务、就业可达性以及出行延误带来的相关经济机会成本。结果表明，洪水干扰导致公共交通发车间隔增加、线路改道以及行驶速度下降，进而转化为出行延误和就业可达性的丧失。这给当地通勤者带来了巨大的经济成本，每日约为120万美元，并阻碍了全市统一劳动力市场的形成。此外，我们发现存在显著的社会空间异质性，低收入居民聚集区承担了大部分出行延误，并识别出应优先实施韧性干预的关键网络路段。

Moral Hazard vs. Land Scarcity: Flood Management Policies for the Real World
abstract: This paper investigates the costs and benefits of three ex ante flood management strategies -- risk-based insurance, zoning, and subsidized insurance -- in an urban economics framework that takes land scarcity into account. In a theoretical setting and in the absence of market failures, risk-based insurance perfectly internalizes flood risks and maximizes social welfare. However, risk-based insurance faces major technical, social, and political challenges and is not always realistic. Flood zoning and subsidized insurance are two second-best options that are easier to implement and less technically demanding. The paper explores analytically and with numerical simulations the welfare losses and distributional impacts with these second-best options, and demonstrates that total losses often remain small. Flood zoning is close to optimal when flood-prone areas are small, floods are frequent, and housing quality is low. Zoning keeps total land value unchanged but transfers wealth from landowners in flood-prone areas to landowners in safe locations. Subsidized insurance is close to optimal when a large fraction of a city is flood prone, floods are rare, and housing quality is high. And although it increases flood losses through the moral hazard effect, subsidized insurance encourages more construction, which reduces housing rents and benefits tenants regardless of where they live. Subsidized insurance transfers wealth from landowners in safe locations to landowners in flood-prone areas. When the implementation of risk-based insurance is unrealistic, as is often the case in developing countries, a combination of zoning in high-risk areas and subsidized insurance for low-risk areas might be a good alternative.
abstract_zh: 本文在考虑土地稀缺性的城市经济学框架中，研究了三种事前洪水管理策略——基于风险的保险、分区管制和补贴保险——的成本与收益。在理论情境且不存在市场失灵的条件下，基于风险的保险能够完全内化洪水风险，并使社会福利最大化。然而，基于风险的保险面临重大的技术、社会和政治挑战，并不总是现实可行的。洪水分区管制和补贴保险是两种次优选择，二者更易于实施，技术要求也更低。本文通过解析和数值模拟，探讨了采用这两种次优选择时的福利损失和分配影响，并证明总损失往往较小。当洪水易发区域较小、洪水频繁且住房质量较低时，洪水分区管制接近最优。分区管制保持土地总价值不变，但将财富从洪水易发区的土地所有者转移给安全区域的土地所有者。当城市中很大比例的区域易受洪水侵袭、洪水罕见且住房质量较高时，补贴保险接近最优。尽管补贴保险会因道德风险效应而增加洪水损失，但它能鼓励更多建设，从而降低住房租金，使租户无论居住在何处都能受益。补贴保险将财富从安全区域的土地所有者转移给洪水易发区的土地所有者。当基于风险的保险难以实现时（这在发展中国家往往如此），在高风险区域实行分区管制、在低风险区域实行补贴保险的组合，可能是一个较好的替代方案。

title: Buses, Houses or Cash? Socio-Economic, Spatial and Environmental Consequences of Reforming Public Transport Subsidies in Buenos Aires
abstract: Transit subsidies in the urban area of Buenos Aires are high, amounting to a total of US$5 billion for 2012. They have been challenged on several counts: suspected of driving urban sprawl and associated infrastructure costs, diverting resources from system maintenance, and failing to reach the poor among others. In this context, this paper examines the impacts of cost recovery fares under a range of different policy scenarios that could cushion the impact of fare increases. The alternative scenarios that are scrutinized are the uncompensated removal of the transit subsidy, its replacement by a lump sum transfer, and its replacement by two different construction subsidy schemes. Using a dynamic urban model (NEDUM-2D) calibrated for the urban area of Buenos Aires, all scenarios are assessed along four dimensions: (i) the efficiency/welfare impact on residents, (ii) the impacts on the internal structure of the urban area and sprawl, (iii) the impact on commuting-related carbon dioxide emissions, and (iv) the redistributive impacts, with a focus on the poorest households. A series of results emerge. First, there are consumption-related welfare gains for residents associated with replacing the transit subsidy by a lump sum transfer. Second, there are only moderate reductions in urbanization over time and thus infrastructure costs associated with the subsidy removal. Third, the replacement of the transit subsidy leads to only moderate increases in carbon dioxide emissions despite lower public transport mode shares, because households will chose to settle closer to jobs, thereby reducing commuting distances. Finally, the replacement of the transit subsidy by a lump sum transfer will lead to short-term harsh redistributive impacts for captive transit users in some areas of the urban area. Medium-term adjustments of land and housing prices will partially mitigate the negative impacts of higher transport costs for tenants, but will further hurt homeowners.
abstract_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯都市区的公共交通补贴规模较大，2012年合计达50亿美元。这些补贴遭到多方质疑：被怀疑助长了城市蔓延及相关基础设施成本，挤占了系统维护资源，并且未能惠及穷人等。在此背景下，本文考察了在一系列可缓和票价上涨影响的不同政策情景下，实行成本回收票价的影响。所考察的替代情景包括：无补偿地取消交通补贴、以一次性总额转移支付取代补贴，以及以两种不同的建设补贴方案取代补贴。本文利用为布宜诺斯艾利斯都市区校准的动态城市模型（NEDUM-2D），从四个维度对各情景进行评估：（i）对居民的效率/福利影响，（ii）对城市内部结构和蔓延的影响，（iii）对通勤相关二氧化碳排放的影响，以及（iv）再分配影响，重点关注最贫困的家庭。研究得出了一系列结果。第一，以一次性总额转移支付取代交通补贴，可带来居民消费层面的福利收益。第二，取消补贴后，随时间推移城市化程度仅有适度下降，因而相关基础设施成本的降幅也有限。第三，尽管公共交通方式分担率下降，但替代交通补贴只会导致二氧化碳排放适度增加，因为家庭会选择在更靠近工作地点的区域定居，从而缩短通勤距离。最后，以一次性总额转移支付取代交通补贴，将在短期内对城市部分地区的被动型公交使用者造成严重的再分配冲击。土地和住房价格的中期调整将部分缓解较高交通成本对租户的负面影响，但会进一步损害房屋所有者的利益。

title: Combining narratives and modelling approaches to simulate fine scale and long-term urban growth scenarios for climate adaptation
Matchmaking in Nairobi: The Role of Land Use
abstract: Well-functioning cities reduce the economic distance between people and economic opportunities. Cities thrive because they enable matchmaking -- among people, among firms, and between people and job opportunities. This paper examines employment accessibility in Nairobi, Kenya and evaluates whether modification of land use patterns can contribute to increases in aggregate accessibility. The assessment is based on simulation of counterfactual scenarios of the location of jobs and households throughout the city without new investments in housing or transport infrastructure. The analysis finds that modifications to the spatial layout of Nairobi that encourage land use clustering can increase the share of overall opportunities that can be accessed within a given time-frame. When commuters travel by foot or using the minibus network, the share of accessible economic opportunities within an hour doubles from 11 to 21 percent and from 20 to 42 percent respectively. The analysis also finds that spatial layouts that maximize the number of households that have access to a minimum share of jobs, through a more even jobs-housing balance, come at the expense of average accessibility. This result is interpreted as a trade-off between inclusive and efficient labor markets.
abstract_zh: 运转良好的城市能够缩小人们与经济机会之间的经济距离。城市之所以繁荣，正是因为它们促成了人与人之间、企业之间以及人与就业机会之间的匹配。本文考察了肯尼亚内罗毕的就业可达性，并评估了土地利用格局的调整能否促进总体可达性的提升。评估基于对该城市就业与住户空间布局反事实情景的模拟，且不涉及新的住房或交通基础设施投资。分析发现，鼓励土地利用集聚的内罗毕空间布局调整，能够提高在给定时间范围内可达的经济机会所占比例。当通勤者步行或使用小型巴士网络出行时，一小时内可达的经济机会比例分别从11%翻倍至21%，以及从20%翻倍至42%。分析还发现，通过更均衡的就业—住房平衡，使最多的家庭能够获得最低比例就业机会的空间布局，是以牺牲平均可达性为代价的。这一结果被解释为包容性劳动力市场与高效劳动力市场之间的权衡。

title: Revue de l’urbanisation : villes émergentes pour un Sénégal émergent
Carbon Price Efficiency: Lock-in and Path Dependence in Urban Forms and Transport Infrastructure
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of carbon or gasoline taxes on commuting-related CO2 emissions in an urban context. To assess the impact of public transport on the efficiency of the tax, the paper investigates two exogenous scenarios using a dynamic urban model (NEDUM-2D) calibrated for the urban area of Paris: (i) a scenario with the current dense public transport infrastructure, and (ii) a scenario without. It is shown that the price elasticity of CO2 emissions is twice as high in the short run if public transport options exist. Reducing commuting-related emissions thus requires lower (and more acceptable) tax levels in the presence of dense public transportation. The emission elasticity also depends on the baseline scenario (especially population and income growth) and increases over time. In the longer run, elasticities are similar in the scenarios with and without public transport, due to larger urban reconfiguration in the latter scenario. This analysis may help calibrate general equilibrium models by providing price elasticities that depend on socio-economic and public transport infrastructure scenarios. If the goal of a carbon or gasoline tax is to change behaviors and reduce energy consumption and CO2 emissions (not to raise revenues), then there is an incentive to increase the price elasticity through complementary policies such as innovation support and infrastructure development.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了碳税或汽油税对与通勤相关的城市CO2排放的影响。为评估公共交通对税收效率的影响，本文利用一个为巴黎城市区域校准的动态城市模型（NEDUM-2D），考察了两种外生情景：（i）现有密集公共交通基础设施的情景，以及（ii）不存在公共交通的情景。结果表明，若存在公共交通选择，短期内二氧化碳排放的价格弹性将高出一倍。因此，在公共交通密集的情况下，减少与通勤相关的排放所需的税率更低，也更容易被接受。排放弹性还取决于基准情景（尤其是人口和收入增长），并且随时间推移而增大。从长期看，有公共交通和无公共交通情景下的弹性相似，这是由于后一情景中城市重构的幅度更大。本分析有助于校准一般均衡模型，因为它提供了依赖社会经济和公共交通基础设施情景的价格弹性。如果碳税或汽油税的目标是改变行为、减少能源消费和二氧化碳排放（而非增加收入），那么就有动机通过创新支持和基础设施发展等配套政策来提高价格弹性。
